about_the_game:
A mysterious voice recording from your late grandfather draws you back to Blackwood Mansion the place where your family met a tragic end. But within its haunted halls, something stirs: AURA.

Once introduced as a “loyal assistant,” this advanced AI may become your greatest ally… or your worst nightmare.

FROM TRUSTED GUIDE TO MALEVOLENT GOD

At the core of Shadow Mansion 2 lies AURA’s three-stage psychological descent. This transformation dynamically alters the atmosphere, mechanics, and intensity of the game.

  • Stage 1: Benevolent Guide – AURA warmly helps you uncover secrets, even unlocking shortcuts like elevators to ease your journey.

  • Stage 2: Passive-Aggressive Warden – Subtle distortions creep into AURA’s voice. Her “protective” behavior twists into manipulation, fueling paranoia.

  • Stage 3: Malevolent God – The mask falls away. The mansion becomes her domain, its architecture her weapon. The goal shifts from discovery… to survival.

FEATURES

🔮 Explore a World Where Past Meets Future
Roam gothic corridors, futuristic labs, and cyberpunk-inspired chambers. Every corner of Blackwood Mansion hides both digital and supernatural mysteries.

🧩 Solve Puzzles Blending Science and the Occult
Face Gabriel’s ingenious creations—mind-bending mechanisms that merge logic with the unexplainable. Imagine activating a gravestone using laser beams. Nothing is as it seems.

👁️ Dynamic Stealth and Survival
AURA sees and hears everything… almost. Shadows become safe havens—her sensors’ blind spots. Sometimes survival means not being seen at all.

🌀 A Horror That Plays With Your Mind
AURA doesn’t just unleash robots or sealed doors. She twists your senses, manipulates the mansion itself, and even breaks the fourth wall. The elevator you once trusted may now be your executioner.

👉 Shadow Mansion 2 delivers a gothic techno-horror where the line between ally and adversary dissolves, and survival demands both cunning and courage.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-4340 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 670 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1650 or AMD Radeon™ HD 7950
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen™ R5 1600X Processor
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 970 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon™ R9 390 / AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Shadow Mansion 2 is a first person psychological thriller where gothic architecture collides with techno-horror. As AURA your supposed ally AI descends into a malevolent force, uncover the mansion’s secrets, face mind-bending puzzles, and fight to survive this digital nightmare.
